newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Sixteen killed in aircrash at Taiwan's defence oustpost of Matsu.
Premier Lien Chan orders probe into plane crash cause, improvement of flight safety.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Domestic airliner crashes in Matsu, killing all 16 on board.
Government to approve alternative five-day work week in two days.
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui decides not to stop by the Caribbean during his upcoming central American visit.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Economics ministry reviews troubles and problems encountered by small and medium-sized enterprises.
Taiwan commercial banks in Hong Kong may be allowed to operate medium- and long-term loan business.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Investment Commission warns 400 firms against their unapproved investment projects in China.
Taiwan to lower tariffs on 386 products, including buses, baby food and mineral water; move expected to reduce tax revenue by T$1 billion.
